subject: DI01000191

title.gu: પરિચય અને Basic Mechanical Tools – ઉપયોગ

intro_text.en: English + Gujarati-friendly notes with English technical keywords. Concepts, components, pipe fittings, hand/power tools and Industry 4.0. Original practice with suggested marks; supervised practical guidance only.
intro_text.gu: સરળ English + ગુજરાતી notes; technical keywords English માં. Concepts, components, pipe fittings, hand/power tools અને Industry 4.0. Practice ના marks સૂચિત છે; practical માટે supervision જરૂરી.

body.en:
Force is an interaction that can change an object’s motion or deform it. It has both magnitude and direction, so it is a vector. SI unit: newton (N). The net force on a constant-mass body is F = ma.

Example: a net 20 N force accelerates a 10 kg trolley at 2 m/s² in the force direction, neglecting other effects. A force may exist even if the object does not move: your push on a fixed wall can be balanced by its reaction.

Distinguish mass (kg) from weight (a gravitational force, N). Near Earth, weight W = mg with g approximately 9.81 m/s².
body.gu:
Force (બળ) એટલે ધક્કો કે ખેંચાણ જે પદાર્થની ગતિ બદલી શકે અથવા તેનો આકાર બદલી શકે. તેનું પ્રમાણ અને દિશા બંને હોય છે. SI unit newton (N) છે. સ્થિર mass માટે net force: F = ma.

ઉદાહરણ: 10 kg ની trolley પર net 20 N બળ લાગે તો acceleration 2 m/s² થાય. દીવાલને ધક્કો મારીએ છતાં તે ન ખસે, તો પણ બળ લાગે છે; બીજા બળો તેને balance કરે છે.

Mass kg માં છે; Weight (વજન) gravity ને કારણે લાગતું બળ છે, એટલે N માં. W = mg; પૃથ્વી નજીક g ≈ 9.81 m/s².

body.en:
Pressure is normal force per unit area: p = F/A for a uniformly loaded area. SI unit pascal (Pa) = N/m². 1 kPa = 1000 Pa; 1 bar = 100,000 Pa.

Worked example: a 100 N normal force distributed over 0.01 m² gives p = 100/0.01 = 10,000 Pa = 10 kPa. The same force over 0.005 m² gives 20 kPa.

A sharp edge concentrates contact force over a small area. Fluid pressure is not the same thing as a total force: force also depends on the effective area. Gauge pressure is relative to local atmospheric pressure; absolute pressure is relative to vacuum.
body.gu:
Pressure (દબાણ) એટલે એકમ ક્ષેત્રફળ પર લંબ દિશામાં લાગતું બળ: p = F/A. આ સૂત્ર અહીં સમાન રીતે વહેંચાયેલા બળ માટે છે. SI unit Pa = N/m². 1 kPa = 1000 Pa; 1 bar = 100,000 Pa.

ગણતરી: 100 N બળ 0.01 m² પર લાગે તો p = 10,000 Pa = 10 kPa. એ જ બળ 0.005 m² પર લાગે તો 20 kPa થાય. ઓછા area પર દબાણ વધારે થાય.

Gauge pressure સ્થાનિક atmospheric pressure ની સરખામણીમાં છે. Absolute pressure vacuum ની સરખામણીમાં છે. Pressure અને કુલ Force એક જ રાશિ નથી.

body.en:
Work transfers energy when a force acts through displacement. For a constant force, W = Fs cos θ; for force parallel to motion, W = Fs. SI unit joule (J) = N·m.

Example: a 50 N force moving a box 3 m along the force direction does 150 J of work on it. Holding a stationary load involves no displacement work on that load, even though the person expends biological energy.

Energy is a conserved physical quantity associated with the ability to cause change/do work. Forms include kinetic, potential, thermal, chemical and electrical energy. Kinetic energy = ½mv²; near-Earth gravitational potential-energy change = mgΔh. Conversion does not create energy from nothing.
body.gu:
Work (કાર્ય) ત્યારે થાય જ્યારે બળને કારણે displacement થાય અને energy transfer થાય. સ્થિર બળ માટે W = Fs cos θ; બળ અને ગતિ એક દિશામાં હોય તો W = Fs. Unit joule (J) = N·m.

ઉદાહરણ: 50 N બળથી box ને એ જ દિશામાં 3 m ખસેડીએ તો Work = 150 J. સ્થિર ભાર પકડી રાખીએ ત્યારે ભારનું displacement શૂન્ય છે, એટલે તેના પર displacement work શૂન્ય; છતાં વ્યક્તિના શરીરમાં energy વપરાય છે.

Energy (ઊર્જા) બદલાવ/કાર્ય સાથે જોડાયેલી conserved રાશિ છે. Kinetic, potential, thermal, chemical અને electrical તેના સ્વરૂપો છે. Kinetic energy = ½mv²; ઊંચાઈ બદલવા માટે ΔPE = mgΔh. Machine energy બનાવતી નથી, તેનું રૂપાંતર કરે છે.

body.en:
Power is work/energy transfer per unit time: P = W/t for an average over the interval. Unit watt (W) = J/s; 1 kW = 1000 W. Do not confuse the symbol W for work with W used as a watt unit.

Example: a machine transferring 6000 J in 3 s has average power 2000 W = 2 kW. Doing the same work in less time needs greater average power. Energy use = average power × time: 1 kW for 2 h is 2 kWh, an energy quantity, not power.

Efficiency η = useful output energy/input energy, or useful output power/input power under consistent operating conditions. Real systems have losses; a 2 kW motor label alone does not specify every load’s energy consumption.
body.gu:
Power (શક્તિ) એટલે એકમ સમયમાં થતું work/energy transfer. Average P = W/t. Unit watt = J/s; 1 kW = 1000 W.

ઉદાહરણ: 6000 J કાર્ય 3 s માં થાય તો Power = 2000 W = 2 kW. એ જ કાર્ય ઓછા સમયમાં થાય તો વધારે average power જોઈએ. 1 kW ઉપકરણ 2 h ચાલે તો energy 2 kWh થાય; kWh energy છે, power નથી.

Efficiency (કાર્યક્ષમતા) = useful output/input. સરખા સમય અને યોગ્ય operating conditions માં power નો ratio લઈ શકાય. વાસ્તવિક machine માં losses થાય છે.

body.en:
A system is the quantity of matter or region selected for study. Everything outside is the surroundings; the boundary separates them.

TypeMass transferEnergy transferTeaching example
Closed systemNoPossibleSealed piston-cylinder with no leakage
Open systemPossiblePossiblePump or turbine with flowing fluid
Isolated systemNoNoIdeal completely insulated and sealed system

A closed system need not have a rigid boundary: a sealed piston may move. An ordinary thermos approximates insulation but is not a perfect isolated system.
body.gu:
System એટલે અભ્યાસ માટે પસંદ કરેલો પદાર્થનો જથ્થો અથવા વિસ્તાર. બહારનું બધું Surroundings અને બંને વચ્ચેની સીમા Boundary છે.

પ્રકારMass transferEnergy transferઉદાહરણ
Closedનહીંથઈ શકેLeakage વગરનું sealed piston-cylinder
Openથઈ શકેથઈ શકેFluid વહેતો pump
Isolatedનહીંનહીંઆદર્શ સંપૂર્ણ insulated અને sealed system

Closed system ની boundary ખસી શકે છે; sealed piston હલતો હોય છતાં mass બહાર જતો નથી. સામાન્ય thermos સંપૂર્ણ isolated નથી, ફક્ત અંદાજિત ઉદાહરણ છે.

body.en:
Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference; its unit is J. Temperature is a state property indicating thermal condition and determining the direction of spontaneous heat transfer. SI temperature unit is kelvin (K); °C is also widely used.

Heat flows spontaneously from higher to lower temperature. Temperature is not the total thermal energy stored: a bucket and a cup at the same temperature can contain different amounts of internal energy.

Conversion: T(K) = t(°C) + 273.15. A change of 1 K equals a change of 1 °C, but 0 °C is 273.15 K. Use kelvin for absolute-temperature gas-law calculations.
body.gu:
Heat (ઉષ્મા) એટલે temperature difference ને કારણે transfer થતી energy; unit J છે. Temperature (તાપમાન) system ની thermal condition દર્શાવતી property છે; SI unit kelvin (K) છે, °C પણ વપરાય છે.

ઉષ્મા સ્વાભાવિક રીતે વધારે temperature થી ઓછા temperature તરફ જાય છે. સમાન temperature ધરાવતા કપ અને ડોલના પાણીમાં internal energy નો જથ્થો સમાન હોવો જરૂરી નથી.

T(K) = t(°C) + 273.15. 1 K નો ફેરફાર અને 1 °C નો ફેરફાર સરખા છે; પણ 0 °C = 273.15 K. Gas laws માં absolute temperature માટે K વાપરવું.

body.en:
Specific heat capacity c is the heat capacity per unit mass for a specified process/condition. SI unit J/(kg·K). For approximately constant c with no phase change, Q = mcΔT.

Worked example: 2 kg water with assumed c = 4200 J/(kg·K) is heated from 20 °C to 30 °C. ΔT = 10 K; Q = 2 × 4200 × 10 = 84,000 J = 84 kJ, ignoring losses and container heating.

This simple formula is not sufficient during boiling with phase change. For gases, heat capacity depends on process, leading to Cp and Cv in Unit 2. Heat capacity of an object (J/K) differs from specific heat capacity (J/kg·K).
body.gu:
Specific heat capacity c એટલે નિર્ધારિત condition/process માં એકમ mass નું temperature એક degree વધારવા માટેની heat capacity. Unit J/(kg·K). c લગભગ સ્થિર હોય અને phase change ન થાય ત્યારે Q = mcΔT.

ઉદાહરણ: 2 kg પાણી માટે c = 4200 J/(kg·K) ધારીએ. 20 °C થી 30 °C એટલે ΔT = 10 K. Q = 2 × 4200 × 10 = 84,000 J = 84 kJ. અહીં vessel અને heat losses અવગણ્યાં છે.

Boiling દરમિયાન phase change માટે માત્ર આ સૂત્ર પૂરતું નથી. Gas માટે process પ્રમાણે Cp અને Cv જુદા પડે છે. Object ની heat capacity J/K છે; specific heat capacity J/(kg·K) છે.

body.en:
A prime mover converts energy from a primary source into mechanical output that drives another machine. Typical examples are steam turbines, IC engines, hydraulic turbines and wind turbines.

SourceExampleOutput use
Fuel/thermalPetrol/diesel engine; steam turbineShaft power for vehicles/generators
Flowing/falling waterHydraulic turbineDrive generator
WindWind turbineDrive generator or mechanical load

An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy and can drive machinery; some definitions restrict “prime mover” to the first primary-energy conversion stage. State the course convention rather than calling every power-transmission part a prime mover. A belt transmits power; it does not supply the primary energy.
body.gu:
Prime mover primary source ની energy ને mechanical output માં ફેરવે છે અને બીજી machine ને ચલાવે છે. IC engine, steam turbine, hydraulic turbine અને wind turbine મુખ્ય ઉદાહરણો છે.

Energy sourceઉદાહરણઉપયોગ
Fuel/heatPetrol/diesel engine; steam turbineVehicle અથવા generator ચલાવવો
પાણીનો પ્રવાહ/ઊંચાઈHydraulic turbineGenerator ચલાવવો
પવનWind turbineMechanical load/generator

Electric motor electrical energy ને mechanical energy માં ફેરવે છે; અમુક વ્યાખ્યાઓમાં prime mover ફક્ત primary-energy conversion માટે વપરાય છે. Belt drive power transmit કરે છે; primary energy બનાવતું નથી.

body.en:
A bolt is an externally threaded fastener used with a matching internal thread, commonly a nut, to clamp parts. A nut provides the mating internal thread. Selection includes thread size/pitch, material/grade, length and operating conditions.

A washer is placed under a nut/bolt head where specified to distribute contact load, protect a surface or provide a defined spacing/locking function. Plain, spring and specialised locking washers serve different purposes; a generic spring washer does not guarantee vibration-proof locking.

Application: a removable machine-cover joint. Use correct matching threads and specified tightening/locking procedure; do not substitute an arbitrary bolt grade or over-tighten.
body.gu:
Bolt બહાર thread ધરાવતો fastener છે. Nut અંદર matching thread ધરાવે છે; બંનેથી parts clamp કરી શકાય. Size, thread pitch, grade અને length યોગ્ય હોવી જરૂરી છે.

Washer nut/bolt head નીચે મૂકાય છે: load વહેંચવા, surface બચાવવા અથવા નિર્ધારિત spacing/locking માટે. Plain washer, spring washer અને special locking washer ની કામગીરી અલગ છે. Spring washer હંમેશાં vibration અટકાવે એવી guarantee નથી.

ઉપયોગ: removable machine cover. ખોટો thread/grade ન વાપરો; specified tightening અનુસરો. વધારે કસવાથી thread અથવા part બગડી શકે.

body.en:
A rivet forms a generally permanent joint by deforming its end to retain the joined parts. It is useful for supported sheet/structural assemblies; removing a conventional rivet usually damages the fastener.

A key fits matching keyways in a shaft and hub to transmit torque and resist relative rotation. Common teaching examples include sunk/parallel and Woodruff keys. A key is not simply a screw holding every pulley in place.

Comparison: a rivet joins parts by formed retention; a key transmits torque between shaft and hub. Neither can be safely selected from shape alone—dimensions, fit, material and load matter.
body.gu:
Rivet નો છેડો deform કરીને સામાન્ય રીતે permanent joint બનાવાય છે. Sheet અથવા યોગ્ય structural assembly માં વપરાય છે; કાઢતી વખતે conventional rivet સામાન્ય રીતે બગડે છે.

Key shaft અને hub ના matching keyways માં બેસે છે અને torque transmit કરે છે, જેથી બંને વચ્ચે relative rotation અટકે. Parallel/sunk key અને Woodruff key ઉદાહરણો છે.

ફરક: Rivet joint બનાવે છે; Key shaft–hub વચ્ચે torque transmit કરે છે. માત્ર આકાર જોઈને selection પૂરતું નથી; size, fit અને load પણ જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
A bearing supports/guides relative motion and carries loads with suitable friction and wear control. Rolling-element bearings use balls or rollers between raceways. Plain bearings use sliding surfaces; a bush is commonly a sleeve-type plain bearing.

Applications: ball/roller bearings support rotating shafts; a replaceable bush guides a pivot or journal in a suitable assembly. Radial loads act broadly across the shaft axis; thrust loads act along it. Bearing ability to carry either depends on design.

Lubrication, alignment, load/speed limits and fit are essential. Bearings reduce/manage friction, not eliminate all friction. Some sealed bearings are pre-lubricated; do not assume every bearing needs routine user grease addition.
body.gu:
Bearing relative motion ને support/guide કરે છે અને load વહન કરે છે, સાથે friction/wear નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Rolling bearing માં balls અથવા rollers હોય છે. Plain bearing માં sliding surfaces હોય છે. Bush સામાન્ય રીતે sleeve પ્રકારનું plain bearing છે.

ઉપયોગ: rotating shaft માટે ball/roller bearing; pivot/journal માટે યોગ્ય bush. Radial load shaft axis ને આડી દિશામાં અને thrust load axis ની દિશામાં લાગે છે; capacity bearing design પર આધારિત છે.

Lubrication, alignment, fit અને speed/load limits મહત્વના છે. Bearing friction સંપૂર્ણ શૂન્ય કરતું નથી. Sealed pre-lubricated bearing માં મનફાવે તેમ grease ન ઉમેરો.

body.en:
A valve starts/stops, directs or regulates fluid flow, or performs a pressure-protection/control function depending on its design.

TypeBasic use
Gate valveIsolation in suitable fully open/closed service
Globe valveFlow regulation/throttling in appropriate service
Ball valveQuick quarter-turn isolation
Check valveAllows intended one-way flow, opposes reverse flow
Safety/relief valveRelieves excess pressure under specified conditions

Material, pressure/temperature rating, fluid compatibility and installation direction matter. Never adjust a safety valve as a classroom experiment or assume shutting one valve safely depressurises a system.
body.gu:
Valve fluid flow ચાલુ/બંધ કરવા, direction બદલવા, flow regulate કરવા અથવા pressure protection માટે વપરાય છે.

પ્રકારમુખ્ય ઉપયોગ
Gate valveયોગ્ય service માં પૂરેપૂરું open/closed isolation
Globe valveFlow regulate/throttle કરવો
Ball valveQuarter-turn થી isolation
Check valveયોગ્ય દિશામાં flow અને reverse flow નો વિરોધ
Safety/relief valveનિર્ધારિત condition માં વધારે pressure છોડવું

Fluid, temperature અને pressure rating યોગ્ય હોવી જોઈએ. Safety valve નું setting જાતે ન બદલો. ફક્ત એક valve બંધ છે એટલે system depressurised છે એમ ન માનો.

body.en:
A spring stores elastic strain energy and exerts a restoring force. Compression, extension, torsion and leaf springs serve different arrangements. Applications include returning a mechanism, maintaining contact and supporting/suspending a load. A spring alone stores/releases energy; damping primarily dissipates energy.

A lever is a rigid member turning about a fulcrum. Effort and load act at lever arms. For an ideal balanced lever, effort × effort arm = load × load arm, using perpendicular distances.

Example: 100 N applied at a 0.4 m perpendicular arm balances 400 N at 0.1 m. Ideal force advantage is 4, but the effort end moves farther. No energy is created.
body.gu:
Spring elastic energy સંગ્રહે છે અને restoring force આપે છે. Compression, extension, torsion અને leaf springs જુદા ઉપયોગ માટે છે. Return mechanism, contact force અને suspension માં વપરાય છે. Spring energy store/release કરે છે; damper energy dissipate કરે છે.

Lever fulcrum આસપાસ ફરતો rigid member છે. Ideal balance માટે Effort × effort arm = Load × load arm; arm લંબ અંતર છે.

ઉદાહરણ: 0.4 m arm પર 100 N effort, 0.1 m arm પર 400 N load ને balance કરે છે. Force advantage 4 છે, પણ effort વધારે અંતર ચાલે છે. Energy બનતી નથી.

body.en:
An O-ring is commonly an elastomer ring with a circular cross-section, fitted into a designed groove and compressed to form a seal. It can serve static and selected dynamic applications when correctly designed.

An oil seal commonly uses a sealing lip around a shaft to retain lubricant and help exclude contaminants. Seal material, shaft finish, speed, temperature, direction and fluid compatibility matter.

Examples: an O-ring seals an appropriate cover/fitting; a rotary lip seal retains gearbox oil around a shaft. A damaged/reused or incompatible seal may leak. Do not treat every rubber ring as interchangeable or remove seals from a pressurised mechanism.
body.gu:
O-ring સામાન્ય રીતે circular cross-section ધરાવતી elastomer ring છે. Groove માં યોગ્ય compression થી seal બને છે. યોગ્ય design હોય તો static અને અમુક dynamic ઉપયોગમાં ચાલે છે.

Oil seal સામાન્ય રીતે shaft આસપાસ sealing lip વડે lubricant અંદર રાખે છે અને dirt બહાર રાખવામાં મદદ કરે છે. Material, shaft finish, speed, temperature અને fluid compatibility મહત્વના છે.

ઉદાહરણ: fitting/cover માટે યોગ્ય O-ring; gearbox shaft માટે rotary oil seal. દરેક rubber ring એકબીજાની જગ્યાએ ન ચાલે. Pressurised mechanism માંથી seal કાઢવી નહીં.

body.en:
A shaft is a machine member used to transmit torque/power and support rotating parts. It often experiences torsion and bending. An axle primarily supports rotating elements and loads; it may be stationary or rotating depending on the arrangement.

In the basic machine-elements distinction, an axle is not primarily used to transmit driving torque. However automotive “drive axles” do transmit torque, so explain the context rather than saying all axles are always stationary.

Examples: a gearbox output shaft carries torque to a coupling; a suitable idler-wheel axle supports the wheel. This topic returns in Unit 8.
body.gu:
Shaft torque/power transmit કરતો member છે અને rotating parts ને support કરે છે. તેમાં torsion અને bending આવી શકે. Axle મુખ્યત્વે rotating parts/load ને support કરે છે; arrangement પ્રમાણે stationary અથવા rotating હોઈ શકે.

Basic machine-elements માં axle નું મુખ્ય કામ driving torque transmit કરવાનું નથી. પરંતુ vehicle માં drive axle torque transmit કરે છે, એટલે “દરેક axle સ્થિર જ હોય” એવું ન લખવું.

ઉદાહરણ: gearbox output shaft power આપે છે; idler wheel axle wheel ને support કરે છે.

h.gu: 1.3.1 સામાન્ય Pipe fittings — કાર્ય પ્રમાણે ઓળખ

body.en:
Pipe fittings join sections, change direction/size, create branches or close an end in a piping system.

FittingApplication
Elbow / bendChange flow direction, commonly 45° or 90°
TeeCreate a branch connection
CrossFour-way connection where suitable
ReducerJoin different nominal sizes
Coupling/socketJoin compatible pipe ends
UnionAllow designed disconnection without rotating long pipe runs
NippleShort pipe section, commonly threaded
Cap / plugClose an end; cap commonly external over end, plug commonly in an opening
FlangeBolted removable connection with appropriate gasket/seal

Nominal pipe size is not always the measured outside diameter. Threads, joining method, schedule/material and pressure/temperature ratings must match. A reducer is not a pressure regulator.
body.gu:
Pipe fittings pipe જોડવા, direction/size બદલવા, branch આપવા અથવા end બંધ કરવા માટે છે.

Fittingઉપયોગ
Elbow/bendFlow direction બદલવી, સામાન્ય 45°/90°
TeeBranch connection
Crossયોગ્ય ચાર-માર્ગ connection
Reducerજુદા nominal size જોડવા
Coupling/socketCompatible pipe ends જોડવા
Unionલાંબી pipe ફેરવ્યા વગર designed disconnection
Nippleટૂંકો pipe section, સામાન્ય threaded
Cap/plugPipe/opening નો end બંધ કરવો
FlangeGasket સાથે bolted removable connection

Nominal size અને માપેલો outside diameter હંમેશાં સમાન નથી. Material, thread અને pressure rating match થવા જોઈએ. Reducer pressure regulator નથી.

body.en:
Example: a cold-water demonstration layout needs a 90° turn and one branch. Select a compatible elbow and tee; use a union where the drawing requires removable service access. Any size change needs a suitable reducer.

  1. Read the drawing and identify direction, branches and nominal sizes.
  2. Choose matching material, thread/joint method and ratings.
  3. Support the layout and avoid forcing misalignment.
  4. Perform only an instructor-approved low-risk demonstration/leak check.

Never loosen a fitting on a live pressurised, hot, fuel or chemical line. Isolation, depressurisation and energy verification require approved procedures; compressed-gas leak testing is not a casual student exercise.
body.gu:
ઉદાહરણ: cold-water demonstration માં 90° વળાંક અને branch જોઈએ તો યોગ્ય elbow અને tee પસંદ કરો. Drawing માં service access જોઈએ ત્યાં union અને size બદલવા reducer વાપરો.

  1. Drawing માં direction, branch અને size ઓળખો.
  2. Material, thread/joint અને rating match કરો.
  3. Layout ને support આપો; misalignment ને બળથી સીધું ન કરો.
  4. Instructor-approved low-risk demonstration જ કરો.

Pressurised, hot, fuel અથવા chemical line નું fitting ઢીલું ન કરો. Isolation અને depressurisation ની approved procedure જરૂરી છે.

title.en: 1.4 Hand Tools: Types, Selection and Use
title.gu: 1.4 Hand Tools: પ્રકાર, પસંદગી અને ઉપયોગ

body.en:
Spanners/wrenches apply torque to suitable fastener flats. Common types are open-ended, ring, combination, socket, adjustable and hex-key tools. A torque wrench controls/applies a specified torque when used correctly.

Choose the correct across-flats size and profile; seat it fully. A ring/socket often offers more surrounding contact than an open end in a suitable location. Adjustable jaws must fit closely; never substitute pliers for a correctly sized spanner.

Pull in a controlled safe position where practicable; do not strike an ordinary spanner or add an improvised extension pipe. Use rated insulated tools only where a qualified electrical procedure requires them—ordinary tools do not make live work safe.
body.gu:
Spanner/wrench fastener ના flats પર torque લગાડે છે. Open-ended, ring, combination, socket, adjustable અને hex-key પ્રકાર છે. Torque wrench યોગ્ય રીતે વાપરવાથી specified torque લગાડવામાં મદદ કરે છે.

સાચી across-flats size પસંદ કરો અને tool સંપૂર્ણ બેસાડો. યોગ્ય જગ્યાએ ring/socket વધારે surrounding contact આપે છે. Adjustable jaw નજીકથી fit થવો જોઈએ. સાચા spanner ની જગ્યાએ pliers ન વાપરો.

Controlled posture રાખો; ordinary spanner ને hammer ન મારો અથવા extension pipe ન લગાવો. સામાન્ય tool થી live electrical work સુરક્ષિત બનતું નથી.

body.en:
Pliers grip, bend or cut material according to jaw design. Combination pliers suit general gripping and specified cutting; long-nose pliers reach small locations; side cutters cut compatible wire; slip-joint/water-pump types adapt to selected gripping sizes.

Use the tool within its material/diameter rating. Not every cutting jaw can cut hardened wire. Do not use pliers on precision shafts/sealing surfaces where teeth may damage the finish.

Plastic-covered handles are not proof of electrical insulation certification. Disconnect/isolate electrical sources under the applicable procedure before ordinary workshop work.
body.gu:
Pliers jaw design પ્રમાણે gripping, bending અથવા cutting કરે છે. Combination pliers general grip માટે, long-nose નાની જગ્યાએ, side cutter compatible wire માટે અને slip-joint/water-pump પ્રકાર બદલાતા grip size માટે છે.

Tool ની rating પ્રમાણે material/diameter પસંદ કરો. દરેક cutter hardened wire કાપી શકતો નથી. Teeth થી precision shaft અથવા sealing surface ને નુકસાન ન કરો.

Plastic handle એટલે certified electrical insulation નહીં. સામાન્ય workshop કામ પહેલાં યોગ્ય isolation જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Screwdrivers turn screws through a matching drive recess. Common profiles include slotted, Phillips, Pozidriv, Torx and hex drivers. Similar-looking cross-head designs are not always interchangeable.

Match tip size/profile, align with the screw axis and use controlled force to reduce slipping/cam-out. A damaged tip can spoil the recess and cause injury. Hold work securely; do not press a screwdriver towards the other hand.

Do not use it as a chisel, pry bar or punch. A dedicated test screwdriver is not a substitute for an approved voltage-verification process.
body.gu:
Screwdriver screw ના matching recess માં torque આપે છે. Slotted, Phillips, Pozidriv, Torx અને hex પ્રકાર છે. Cross-head દેખાય એટલે દરેક tip એકસરખી નથી.

સાચી profile અને size લો; screw axis સાથે alignment રાખો અને controlled force આપો. ઘસાયેલ tip થી recess બગડે અને tool slip થઈ શકે. Work securely પકડો; tool બીજા હાથ તરફ દબાવો નહીં.

Screwdriver ને chisel, pry bar અથવા punch તરીકે ન વાપરો. Test screwdriver approved voltage verification નો વિકલ્પ નથી.

body.en:
A cold chisel cuts/chips suitable unheated metal using a hammer. Flat, cross-cut, round-nose and diamond-point shapes suit different features. Correct edge condition, secure work, eye protection and shielding against flying chips are essential. Do not use a mushroomed/damaged striking head.

A file removes small amounts of material with many cutting teeth. Flat, round, half-round, square and triangular shapes fit different surfaces; cut/grade controls removal and finish. A single-cut and double-cut tooth pattern serve different work.

Fit a proper handle over the tang and clamp the work. In conventional hand filing, apply controlled cutting pressure on the forward stroke and lighten the return. Do not strike a file: hardened files can break.
body.gu:
Cold chisel hammer વડે યોગ્ય unheated metal ને chip/cut કરે છે. Flat, cross-cut, round-nose અને diamond-point પ્રકાર છે. Work secure, eye protection અને flying chips થી shielding જરૂરી છે. Mushroomed/damaged head વાળું chisel ન વાપરો.

File ઘણા નાના teeth વડે material દૂર કરે છે. Flat, round, half-round, square અને triangular shapes છે. Cut/grade પ્રમાણે finish અને removal બદલાય છે.

Tang પર યોગ્ય handle લગાવો; work clamp કરો. Conventional filing માં forward stroke પર controlled cutting pressure અને return પર હળવો pressure રાખો. File ને hammer ન મારો; hardened file તૂટી શકે.

body.en:
A hacksaw has a frame, handle, tensioning arrangement and replaceable toothed blade for cutting compatible material.

  1. Choose blade material and tooth pitch for the work section.
  2. Fit and tension according to the tool instruction; conventional hand blades commonly cut on the forward stroke.
  3. Clamp the work and begin a controlled cut.
  4. Use a sufficient length of blade without twisting or excessive force.

Thin sections need a suitable finer tooth pitch so several teeth engage rather than snag. A loose, cracked or incorrectly fitted blade can break. Keep hands away from the cut and wear appropriate eye protection.
body.gu:
Hacksaw માં frame, handle, tensioning arrangement અને replaceable toothed blade હોય છે. યોગ્ય material કાપવા માટે છે.

  1. Work section પ્રમાણે blade અને tooth pitch પસંદ કરો.
  2. Instruction મુજબ blade fit/tension કરો; conventional hand hacksaw સામાન્ય forward stroke પર કાપે છે.
  3. Work clamp કરીને controlled cut શરૂ કરો.
  4. Blade ને twist કે વધારે force આપ્યા વગર યોગ્ય લંબાઈનો stroke લો.

પાતળા section માટે finer pitch થી અનેક teeth engage થાય છે. Loose/cracked blade તૂટી શકે. Cut થી હાથ દૂર અને eye protection રાખો.

body.en:
Hammers deliver controlled impact. Ball-peen hammers suit selected fitting/riveting work; cross-peen/straight-peen shapes direct metal-working impact; soft-faced hammers reduce marking in suitable assembly tasks. A claw hammer is primarily associated with nail work, not a universal metal-fitting hammer.

Check handle security, head/face condition and appropriate size. Secure work and keep others clear of flying chips. Do not strike one hardened hammer face against another or use an impact tool with cracks/loose head.

A soft face reduces marking but does not guarantee zero damage. Use the specified assembly method rather than hammering bearings or precision components arbitrarily.
body.gu:
Hammer controlled impact આપે છે. Ball-peen fitting/riveting માટે, cross/straight-peen પસંદ કરેલા metal work માટે અને soft-faced hammer યોગ્ય assembly માં marking ઓછી કરવા માટે છે. Claw hammer મુખ્યત્વે nail work માટે છે.

Handle/head secure છે કે નહીં, face ની condition અને size ચકાસો. Work secure અને આસપાસના લોકો chips થી દૂર રાખો. બે hardened hammer faces એકબીજા સામે ન મારો; cracked અથવા loose-head tool ન વાપરો.

Soft face થી damage ની guarantee શૂન્ય નથી. Precision bearing ને મનફાવે તેમ hammer ન મારવો.

body.en:
Example A: loosen a hexagonal nut with an accessible surrounding space: choose a correctly sized ring/socket arrangement, not gripping pliers.

Example B: finish a concave edge: choose a suitable round/half-round file with a handle and appropriate cut.

Example C: cut a supported thin metal section: choose a hacksaw blade pitch suitable for the section and clamp it.

Selection checklist: task, material, size/access, condition/rating, workholding, protection and manufacturer procedure. No tool use is claimed to have been physically demonstrated in this lesson.
body.gu:
A: Hex nut ની આસપાસ જગ્યા હોય તો સાચી size નો ring/socket લો; pliers નહીં.

B: Concave edge finish કરવા handle સાથે યોગ્ય round/half-round file લો.

C: પાતળું metal section કાપવા યોગ્ય pitch ની hacksaw blade લો અને work clamp કરો.

Checklist: કામ, material, size/access, tool condition/rating, workholding, protection અને approved procedure. આ lesson માં વાસ્તવિક tool demonstration કર્યાનો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
A power tool uses an external energy source such as electricity, a battery or compressed air to drive its working action. Examples include portable drills, impact drivers, grinders, powered saws and pneumatic fastening tools.

ToolTypical useSelection caution
DrillMake holes with suitable bitsMaterial/bit/speed and secure workholding
Impact driver/wrenchSpecified fastening tasksImpact-rated accessories; do not assume final torque
Angle grinderRated grinding/cutting tasksExact disc rating, guard and application
Pneumatic toolAir-driven operationCorrect regulated supply and hose/tool compatibility

Task, accessory rating and training matter. A grinding wheel must not be treated as a general-purpose saw disc; machine guards/interlocks must remain functional.
body.gu:
Power tool electric supply, battery અથવા compressed air જેવી energy થી કામ કરે છે. Drill, impact driver, grinder, powered saw અને pneumatic tool ઉદાહરણો છે.

Toolઉપયોગધ્યાન
Drillયોગ્ય bit થી holeMaterial/bit/speed અને clamp
Impact driver/wrenchSpecified fasteningImpact-rated accessory; final torque આપોઆપ સાચો નહીં
Angle grinderRated grinding/cuttingસાચો disc, guard અને rating
Pneumatic toolAir-driven કામRegulated supply અને compatible hose

Task અને training જરૂરી છે. Grinding wheel ને કોઈપણ saw disc ની જેમ ન વાપરો. Guard/interlock દૂર ન કરો.

body.en:
Advantages: faster repetitive work, lower manual effort, consistent output when correctly controlled, and access to higher cutting/driving power.

Disadvantages: purchase/maintenance cost, dependence on energy supply, noise/vibration/dust, accessory wear and more severe injury risk if mishandled. Portability depends on cable/battery/air-hose arrangements.

  1. Use a trained, authorised operator and intact appropriate guard/accessory.
  2. Check tool/cord/battery/hoses and isolate energy before accessory changes.
  3. Secure work; wear task-appropriate eye/hearing/dust protection.
  4. Keep loose clothing/hair clear. Do not wear gloves where they could entangle in exposed rotation; follow the task-specific procedure.
  5. Stop for abnormal vibration, overheating or damage.

No live power-tool operating practical is conducted here. Do not bypass guards or use compressed air to clean the body/clothing.
body.gu:
ફાયદા: repetitive કામ ઝડપથી, ઓછો manual effort, યોગ્ય control હોય તો consistent output અને વધારે working power.

મર્યાદા: cost/maintenance, power supply પર આધાર, noise/vibration/dust અને ખોટા ઉપયોગથી ગંભીર injury. Cable, battery અને hose પ્રમાણે portability બદલાય છે.

  1. Trained operator અને યોગ્ય intact guard/accessory જરૂરી.
  2. Tool/cord/battery/hose તપાસો; accessory બદલતાં energy isolate કરો.
  3. Work clamp અને task-appropriate eye/hearing/dust protection રાખો.
  4. Loose clothes/hair દૂર. ખુલ્લા rotating parts માં glove ફસાઈ શકે ત્યાં glove ન પહેરો; approved procedure અનુસરો.
  5. Abnormal vibration/heat/damage થાય તો બંધ કરો.

અહીં live power-tool practical નથી. Guard bypass ન કરો; compressed air થી શરીર/કપડાં સાફ ન કરો.

body.en:
Industry 4.0 describes connected, data-informed manufacturing combining physical equipment with sensing, computation and communication. Common ideas include IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things), cyber-physical systems, automation, analytics and digital integration.

Example: a motor’s vibration and temperature sensors send readings to a controller/gateway. A monitoring system compares trends and alerts maintenance staff. Staff verify the evidence before acting. This can support condition-based/predictive maintenance; it does not guarantee perfect failure prediction.

Automation without connectivity/data integration is not automatically the entire Industry 4.0 concept. A digital twin is a model linked to physical-system information; not every dashboard is a validated digital twin.
body.gu:
Industry 4.0 માં physical machines સાથે sensors, computation અને communication જોડાય છે. IIoT, cyber-physical systems, automation, analytics અને digital integration મુખ્ય ખ્યાલો છે.

ઉદાહરણ: motor ના vibration/temperature sensors readings controller/gateway ને આપે. Monitoring system trends જોઈને maintenance alert આપે. Staff evidence verify કરીને પગલું લે. આ condition-based/predictive maintenance માં મદદ કરે, પણ દરેક failure પહેલાંથી પકડવાની guarantee નથી.

ફક્ત automation એટલે આખું Industry 4.0 નહીં. Digital twin physical system ની માહિતી સાથે જોડાયેલ model છે; દરેક dashboard validated twin નથી.

body.en:
Potential benefits: better traceability, faster visibility of problems, improved scheduling and informed maintenance. Challenges: investment, skills, interoperability, sensor/data quality, cybersecurity and privacy.

A network fault or poor sensor calibration can create misleading readings. Systems need access control, secure updates and safety-engineered local protection. Do not connect unknown devices or bypass safety interlocks merely to collect data.

Unit revision: define basic quantities with units; identify every listed mechanical component and pipe fitting; choose suitable hand/power tools; explain connected manufacturing with a realistic example.
body.gu:
સંભવિત લાભ: traceability, fault ની વહેલી જાણ, scheduling અને maintenance decisions માં મદદ. પડકાર: investment, skills, જુદા systems ની compatibility, sensor/data quality, cybersecurity અને privacy.

Network fault અથવા ખોટું calibration misleading reading આપે. Access control, secure updates અને local safety protection જરૂરી છે. Data મેળવવા safety interlock bypass ન કરો અથવા અજાણ device ન જોડો.

Revision: quantities/units, દરેક component/fitting નું કાર્ય, યોગ્ય hand/power tool selection અને Industry 4.0 નું ઉદાહરણ તૈયાર કરો.

h.en: Practice 1 — Define Force, Pressure, Work and Power with SI units.
h.gu: Practice 1 — Force, Pressure, Work અને Power ની વ્યાખ્યા SI units સાથે આપો.

body.en:
Suggested marks: 4; original practice, not official GTU allocation.

Model answer / outline: Force: interaction changing motion/deformation, N. Pressure: normal force/area, Pa. Work: force-displacement energy transfer, J. Power: work/time, W. State directional/constant-force assumptions for formulae.

For longer answers, expand with the detailed notes and labelled sketches.
body.gu:
સૂચિત marks: 4; આ original practice છે, official GTU marks allocation નથી.

જવાબ / outline: Force: motion/deformation બદલતું interaction, N. Pressure: normal force/area, Pa. Work: force–displacement energy transfer, J. Power: work/time, W. Formula ની condition જણાવો.

લાંબા જવાબમાં detailed notes અને labelled sketches ઉમેરો.

h.en: Practice 2 — Calculate pressure for 100 N over 0.01 m².
h.gu: Practice 2 — 100 N બળ 0.01 m² પર લાગતાં Pressure ગણો.

For longer answers, expand with the detailed notes and labelled sketches.
body.gu:

h.en: Practice 3 — Calculate work for 50 N over 3 m in the force direction.
h.gu: Practice 3 — 50 N બળની દિશામાં 3 m displacement માટે Work ગણો.

Suggested marks: 3; original practice, not official GTU allocation.

For longer answers, expand with the detailed notes and labelled sketches.
body.gu:
સૂચિત marks: 3; આ original practice છે, official GTU marks allocation નથી.

જવાબ / outline: W=Fs=50×3=150 J; બળ સ્થિર અને displacement ની દિશામાં છે.

લાંબા જવાબમાં detailed notes અને labelled sketches ઉમેરો.

h.en: Practice 4 — Calculate average power for 6000 J in 3 s.
h.gu: Practice 4 — 6000 J કાર્ય 3 s માં થાય તો average Power ગણો.

terms.gu: Approved procedure અનુસરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

q.en: What is Force?

a.en: An interaction that can change motion or deform a body; unit N.
a.gu: ગતિ અથવા આકાર બદલી શકે એવો interaction; unit N.

q.en: Define Pressure.

a.en: Normal force per unit area; p=F/A, unit Pa.
a.gu: એકમ area પર normal force; p=F/A, unit Pa.

q.en: When is displacement work zero?

a.en: When displacement is zero, or force has no component along it.
a.gu: Displacement zero હોય અથવા તેની દિશામાં force નો component ન હોય.

q.en: What is Power?

a.en: Rate of work/energy transfer; unit watt.
a.gu: Work/energy transfer નો દર; unit watt.

q.en: Is kWh a power unit?

a.en: No, it is an energy unit.
a.gu: ના, તે energy નું unit છે.

q.en: What is a closed system?

a.en: Mass cannot cross its boundary, but energy may.
a.gu: Boundary પાર mass નથી જતો; energy જઈ શકે.

q.en: How do Heat and Temperature differ?

a.en: Heat is energy transfer due to temperature difference; temperature is a state property.
a.gu: Heat temperature difference થી energy transfer છે; Temperature state property છે.

q.en: Give the specific-heat formula.

a.en: Q=mcΔT for approximately constant c without phase change.
a.gu: Phase change વગર લગભગ સ્થિર c માટે Q=mcΔT.

q.en: What does a prime mover do?

a.en: Converts primary-source energy to mechanical output.
a.gu: Primary energy ને mechanical output માં ફેરવે.

q.en: What is a washer used for?

a.en: Specified load distribution, surface protection or spacing/locking.
a.gu: નિર્ધારિત load distribution, surface protection અથવા spacing/locking.

q.en: What is a rivet?

a.en: A fastener forming a generally permanent joint by deformation.
a.gu: Deformation થી સામાન્ય permanent joint બનાવતો fastener.

q.en: What is a key used for?

a.en: Torque transfer between a shaft and hub through matching keyways.
a.gu: Matching keyways વડે shaft–hub વચ્ચે torque transfer.

q.en: What is a bush?

a.en: Commonly a sleeve-type plain bearing.
a.gu: સામાન્ય રીતે sleeve પ્રકારનું plain bearing.

q.en: Do bearings eliminate all friction?
q.gu: Bearing બધું friction દૂર કરે છે?

a.en: No, they manage/reduce friction with suitable design and lubrication.
a.gu: ના; યોગ્ય design/lubrication થી friction નિયંત્રિત/ઓછું થાય.

q.en: What is the main role of a check valve?

a.en: Oppose reverse flow while allowing intended forward flow.
a.gu: યોગ્ય forward flow આપવો અને reverse flow નો વિરોધ.

q.en: Does a spring create energy?

a.en: No, it stores and releases elastic energy.
a.gu: ના; elastic energy store અને release કરે.

q.en: What is the lever fulcrum?

a.en: The pivot about which the lever turns.
a.gu: જે pivot આસપાસ lever ફરે છે.

q.en: What is an O-ring?

a.en: A commonly elastomeric ring sealing by designed compression in a groove.
a.gu: Groove માં designed compression થી seal આપતી સામાન્ય elastomer ring.

q.en: What is an oil seal used for?

a.en: Retain lubricant and help exclude contaminants around a suitable shaft.
a.gu: યોગ્ય shaft આસપાસ lubricant રાખવા અને dirt રોકવામાં મદદ.

q.en: Are all axles stationary?

a.en: No. Arrangement and terminology vary; some rotate and drive axles transmit torque.
a.gu: ના; arrangement મુજબ rotate કરી શકે અને drive axle torque transmit કરે.

q.en: Which fitting changes direction?

a.en: An elbow or bend.
a.gu: Elbow અથવા bend.

q.en: Which fitting provides a branch?

a.en: A tee in a suitable arrangement.
a.gu: યોગ્ય arrangement માં tee.

q.en: Why use a union?

a.en: Designed disconnection without rotating long pipe sections.
a.gu: લાંબી pipe ફેરવ્યા વગર designed disconnection માટે.

q.en: Why choose a matching spanner size?

a.en: To achieve proper contact and reduce slipping/damage.
a.gu: યોગ્ય contact અને slipping/damage ઓછું કરવા.

q.en: Can pliers replace every spanner?
q.gu: Pliers દરેક spanner ની જગ્યાએ ચાલે?

a.en: No. Use the tool designed for the task.
a.gu: ના; કામ માટે designed tool લો.

q.en: Why fit a handle to a file?

a.en: To control it safely and protect the hand from the tang.
a.gu: સુરક્ષિત control અને tang થી હાથ બચાવવા.

q.en: Why is hacksaw tooth pitch important?
q.gu: Hacksaw tooth pitch શા માટે મહત્વનું?

a.en: Suitable tooth engagement reduces snagging/breakage for the work section.
a.gu: Work section મુજબ teeth engage થતાં snagging/breakage ઓછું થાય.

q.en: Can an ordinary screwdriver be a chisel?

a.en: No, it is not designed for that impact/cutting task.
a.gu: ના; તે impact/cutting માટે designed નથી.

q.en: Name two power tools.

a.en: A portable drill and a suitable angle grinder.
a.gu: Portable drill અને યોગ્ય angle grinder.

q.en: Must power be isolated before accessory changes?

a.en: Yes, according to the approved tool procedure.
a.gu: હા, approved tool procedure પ્રમાણે.

q.en: What does IIoT mean?

a.en: Industrial Internet of Things.
a.gu: Industrial Internet of Things: industrial devices ની connected sensing/communication.

q.en: Does Industry 4.0 guarantee perfect predictions?

a.en: No. Data quality, models, validation and safe human decisions matter.
a.gu: ના; data quality, model, validation અને safe decisions જરૂરી છે.
